incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), applicable incorporation and governance provisions including Articles 10, 11, 27, 28, 32, 37, 46, 59 and 68; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 4, 28 and 30; Regulation of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Company Registration; Civil Aviation Law of the People's Republic of China, relevant airworthiness and parts supply provisions; Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; online National Enterprise Registration Integrated Service Platform (zwfw.samr.gov.cn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Incorporation Registration Application Form, Business License Application, and Articles of Association of [CN_WFOE_LTD]
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital is imposed for a WFOE engaged in wholesale distribution of certified civil aircraft parts. Under the 2023 Company Law, shareholders must pay the full subscribed capital within five years from incorporation unless the Articles prescribe a shorter period. No blocked escrow account rule or pre-incorporation paid-up deposit is required at the national level; the foreign investor must remit contributed capital only through a licensed Chinese bank account in compliance with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange foreign direct investment registration procedure.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CN_WFOE_LTD] was duly held on [Date] at [Time] at [Address]. The following directors were present: [Director 1] and [Director 2]. The meeting constituted a quorum in accordance with the Articles of Association. After deliberation, the Board unanimously adopted the following resolutions: 1. SHARE CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION: RESOLVED, that the issued and subscribed share capital of the Company is [Currency] [Amount], consisting of [Number] ordinary shares of [Currency] [Amount] each, all of which have been validly subscribed by the Sole Shareholder in accordance with the Foreign Investment Law and the Company Law. The Board accepts the subscription and instructs the Legal Representative to deposit the first tranche of capital into the Company capital contribution account no later than [Date] and to ensure that the total subscribed capital is fully paid in no later than [Date]. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is hereby fixed at [Complete Address], and the Legal Representative is authorized to execute the lease or title documentation, to file the address with the registration authority, and to maintain the registered office as the principal place of business. 3. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that [Bank Name and Branch] is appointed as the principal bank of the Company, and the Legal Representative, General Manager and Finance Manager are hereby authorized, in any two-signature combination, to open, maintain and operate bank accounts, sign banking mandates, execute electronic banking instructions, receive SWIFT wires, and manage the funds of the Company. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS: RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Executive Director and Legal Representative, [Name] is appointed Supervisor, and [Name] is appointed General Manager, each for a term of three years, with authority to act within the scope prescribed by law and the Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Legal Representative and General Manager are authorized to prepare, execute and submit all applications, contracts, licenses and filings necessary to complete statutory incorporation, obtain the business license, apply for civil aviation parts distribution registration, and complete registration with tax, customs, public security, environment and fire authorities. RESOLVED, that this resolution is effective immediately and remains in force until amended or revoked by a subsequent board resolution. RESOLVED, that the corporate seal impression and the signatures below are conclusive evidence of the adoption of this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Negative List Pre-Check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online National Enterprise Registration Service; local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three to five proposed Chinese-language corporate names through the SAMR integrated portal and confirm that the selected name contains a lawful trade name, an industry feature such as aviation equipment trade, and the limited liability company suffix. Perform a foreign investment negative list pre-check, confirming that wholesale distribution of surplus civil aircraft parts is a permitted foreign investment sector not subject to equity restrictions. The foreign corporate investor must provide a certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, board resolution authorizing the incorporation of a wholly foreign-owned subsidiary, a notarized power of attorney, and passport or corporate ID evidence for the designated legal representative. Once pre-approved, the name notice remains valid for six months and must be used in the formal incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name alternatives
Foreign investor certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing
Apostilled or legalized foreign investor documents with certified translation
Executed power of attorney to the registration agent
Passport or corporate ID of the designated legal representative
Foreign investment negative list self-assessment statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is queried or rejected, obtain the written grounds from SAMR within five working days and submit revised alternatives or a statement removing prohibited elements; the name notice is renewable for an additional six months if no legal conflict exists.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Application and Articles of Association Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; SAMR integrated registration window or online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the formal Foreign-Invested Enterprise Incorporation Registration Application with the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation. Submit the signed Articles of Association, share subscription statement, initial board resolution, supervisor consent, legal representative identity certificate, address certificate for the registered office, and legalization or apostille evidence for the foreign investor. The business scope must contain only permitted descriptions, including wholesale, import, export and distribution of certified civil aircraft rotables and avionics surplus. After examination, SAMR will assign a Uniform Social Credit Code and issue the Foreign-Invested Enterprise business license. The original business license must be kept at the registered office, and any discrepancy in registration data must be notified to SAMR within ten working days.
required_dossiers: Pre-approved name notice
Signed Articles of Association
Foreign-Invested Enterprise Registration Application Form
Share subscription statement and capital contribution plan
First board resolution and supervisor consent
Identity certificates of the director, legal representative, supervisor and general manager
Registered office lease or property ownership certificate
Apostilled or legalized foreign investor documents with certified translation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the incorporation application is suspended or queried, respond to the SAMR supplementary notice within fifteen working days; amend the Articles of Association, replace missing certificates, or narrow the business scope if the authority determines that a separate license is required before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Carving, Post-Registration Integration and Corporate Governance Book Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Public Security Bureau-authorized seal engraving enterprise; local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; local Tax Service Bureau.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the business license is issued, apply for the enterprise legal person seal, financial seal, invoice seal and contract seal from a licensed seal engraving enterprise recorded by the Municipal Public Security Bureau. Complete post-incorporation filings through the SAMR multi-certificate integration system so that the tax authority, statistical authority, social insurance agency and human resources authority are automatically notified. Establish a statutory corporate governance book containing the board minutes, shareholder resolution, share ledger, officer appointment instruments and Articles of Association. Verify the legal representative and supervisor information in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and correct any data errors before proceeding to bank account opening.
required_dossiers: Original business license
Seal carving application form and approval record
Legal representative identity certificate
Board resolution approving post-registration filings
Articles of Association and registered office proof
National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System verification record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal engraving or post-registration integration is delayed, request an official receipt from the seal vendor; if tax registration does not flow automatically, visit the Tax Service Bureau with the business license and SAMR confirmation to complete the one-stop registration manually.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Direct Investment Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank under the People's Bank of China account framework; State Administration of Foreign Exchange via integrated bank declaration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a basic RMB deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at a licensed commercial bank after receipt of the business license and company seals. Present the board resolution, legal representative identity certificate, finance manager identity certificate, registered office lease and business license. Complete the foreign direct investment foreign exchange registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the receiving bank, and ensure that all capital contribution wires are sent from the foreign investor's own overseas account with the wire purpose marked as registered capital. The bank must verify beneficial ownership and the source of funds under AML enhanced due diligence. Maintain bank statements and remittance records for annual statutory filing.
required_dossiers: Business license
Standard company seals
Board resolution authorizing bank account opening
Legal representative and finance manager identity certificates
Articles of Association
Registered office lease
Foreign direct investment foreign exchange registration application
AML beneficial ownership questionnaire and source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening under AML risk review, provide enhanced beneficial ownership proof, source of funds evidence and a corporate authorization letter from the foreign investor; if SAFE registration is queried, correct the capital contribution wiring instructions and refile the foreign direct investment declaration through the same bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Aviation Parts Distribution Registration and Airworthiness Compliance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) regional Airworthiness Department; local CAAC office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing aviation parts trading, apply to the CAAC regional airworthiness office for registration as a civil aviation materials and parts distributor. File the company quality control manual, parts traceability procedure, approved supplier matrix, and airworthiness release documentation for surplus rotables and avionics. The application must describe warehousing, inspection, quarantine segregation, shelf-life control and counterfeit parts prevention. For imported surplus parts, include customs registration evidence and confirmation that each part is accompanied by an EASA Form 1, FAA Form 8130-3 or equivalent CAAC-accepted release certificate. CAAC registration is a precondition for contracting with airlines and maintenance organizations; any change to the warehouse address or responsible manager requires a re-filing before operations continue.
required_dossiers: Business license and Articles of Association
CAAC parts distributor registration application form
Quality management and parts traceability manual
Airworthiness release certificates for surplus rotables and avionics
Approved supplier and consignment agreements
Warehouse layout and fire safety certificate
Customs import and export registration proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CAAC suspends or queries the distributor registration, stop aircraft part sales immediately and submit a corrective action plan addressing traceability gaps, quality manual deficiencies or counterfeit part prevention; reapply after CAAC closes the suspension.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment Filing, Fire Safety Acceptance and Worksite Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Section; local Emergency Management Bureau.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Environmental Impact Assessment registration form with the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau for the warehousing and distribution site. Implement stormwater management and waste segregation, and execute a hazardous waste collection agreement with a licensed disposal enterprise for any contaminated filters, rags, oils or unserviceable aircraft parts. Apply to the local Fire and Rescue Section for building fire safety acceptance and the occupancy fire certificate. The site must have fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, exit signage, fire-fighting access and an emergency response plan. File the occupational health and safety notification with the Emergency Management Bureau and obtain a structural load verification certificate for all racking before storing commercial aircraft parts.
required_dossiers: EIA registration form and site floor plan
Lease and property ownership certificate
Fire safety design documents and fire equipment list
Hazardous waste disposal contract and manifest
Emergency response plan
Occupational health and safety notification form
Racking structural load inspection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA or fire clearance is challenged, implement required fire separation, emergency lighting, hazardous waste containment or structural reinforcement within ten working days; file an amended EIA registration form and resubmit to the same bureau before storing inventory.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) Regional Airworthiness Department; Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; Fire and Rescue Section; Emergency Management Bureau.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Civil Aviation Material and Parts Distributor Registration Certificate (Surplus Certified Rotables and Avionics category)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (EIA Registration Form) is sufficient for non-hazardous warehousing and distribution of surplus aircraft parts. A Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is required only if the site stores or handles hazardous waste, contaminated aircraft parts, waste oil or chemicals in quantities exceeding 50 tons, or if the floor area exceeds 10,000 square meters. For a pure corporate office with no physical storage, this is Not Applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: if connected to the municipal sewage network, effluent must meet GB/T 31962-2015 with COD no greater than 500 mg/L, suspended solids no greater than 400 mg/L and ammonia nitrogen no greater than 45 mg/L; direct discharge to surface water is prohibited for this project. Air emissions: no coating or solvent cleaning operations are authorized unless a VOC treatment system is installed and fugitive emissions meet GB 37822-2019 limits. Hazardous waste: storage period shall not exceed six months, transfer shall be documented through the electronic manifest system to a licensed disposal enterprise, and contaminated rags, filters, absorbent materials and used oil must be classified, labeled and segregated from airworthy parts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate and Occupancy Fire Permit from the local Fire and Rescue Section; civil defense and structural load inspection certificate for the warehouse; occupational health and safety notification and emergency response plan approval from the local Emergency Management Bureau. All physical premises must pass fire safety inspection before any surplus commercial aircraft parts are received, stored or distributed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, operating through the local competent tax authority at the WFOE's registered address and the nationwide 'Electronic Tax Bureau' (China Tax e-Service) electronic tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign investor obtains approval/registration from the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), which issues the Business License carrying the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). Step 2: Under the integrated one-form one-window registration reform, tax registration is completed automatically with the STA when the Business License is issued, and the USCC becomes the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for both Corporate Income Tax and VAT. Step 3: The enterprise logs into the Electronic Tax Bureau, verifies its basic registration data, electronic invoice quota, and tax type (VAT general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer). Step 4: For non-resident investors without a permanent establishment, the WFOE acts as the withholding agent for Chinese-source income tax and ensures the non-resident's identifier is recorded in the tax registration. Step 5: The enterprise completes VAT general taxpayer registration if it intends to claim export VAT refunds; compulsory general taxpayer registration applies once annual taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC tax system does not provide check-the-box or similar flow-through elections for a WFOE LLC. The WFOE is a resident enterprise taxed on worldwide income under the Enterprise Income Tax Law, and no hybrid mismatch election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax) on supplies of goods and services within the PRC under the VAT Law and its implementing regulations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable sales; a taxpayer with annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 must register as a VAT general taxpayer, while smaller taxpayers may voluntarily register if they meet accounting requirements. A newly formed WFOE is tax-registered at incorporation regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates the Golden Tax Phase IV system and mandates the issuance of Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices (XML digital invoices) through the Electronic Invoice Service Platform, with real-time transmission of invoice data to the STA. The platform validates the buyer's Unified Social Credit Code, applies an anti-fraud digital stamp, and records every invoice in the National VAT Invoice Management System before delivery. Taxpayers must archive the XML source files and are prohibited from tampering with e-invoice data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of surplus commercial aircraft parts is eligible for zero-rating and input VAT refund under the PRC export tax rebate regime if the WFOE is a VAT general taxpayer, the goods are physically declared for export and cleared by PRC Customs, the goods are not restricted or prohibited for export, the export proceeds are received from an overseas buyer and repatriated to China within the statutory verification period, and the purchase-side VAT special invoices are valid and verified. Zero-rating is substantiated by the customs export declaration data linked to the VAT return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form for Goods (customs-verified exit record and export customs clearance endorsement)
Original Commercial Invoice and detailed Packing List matching the export contract, goods description, quantity, and value
Bill of Lading (or original Air Waybill) evidencing the physical export movement of the aircraft parts out of PRC territory
Export Proceeds Collection record / bank Foreign Exchange Settlement Receipt issued by a SAFE-designated bank proving repatriation and settlement of the export foreign exchange income
Original VAT Special Invoice(s) for the purchase of the aircraft parts to support input VAT credit offset
Export Sales Contract and related commercial or technical documents (including airworthiness or surplus condition certificates) required to verify the transaction for customs and tax audit purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export tax refund claims are subject to STA risk-control review and post-claim audits; files must be retained for at least 10 years. If the exported goods are not actually exported, the export declaration is fraudulent, or the proceeds are not repatriated within the deadline, the tax authority will retroactively claw back the refunded VAT, impose a late-payment surcharge, and may impose an administrative fine of 50% to 5 times the amount fraudulently refunded under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection. Criminal liability for fraudulent export VAT refunds may arise under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, with penalties including imprisonment, fine, and confiscation of property.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is not fully convertible on the capital account; current account transactions enjoy free convertibility under a verified documentary framework. Foreign-funded enterprises (WFOEs) may convert foreign currency registered capital into RMB for legitimate operating purposes after completing FDI Foreign Exchange Registration with SAFE. Capital injections must be booked through a domestic bank's Capital Account (Capital Verification) mechanism, and the use of RMB converted capital is subject to the Foreign Investment Access Negative List and thin-capitalization scrutiny. Profit remittance is permitted upon submission of audited financial statements, tax completion certificates, and an FX payment application; dividends remitted abroad are treated as current account outflows and are generally remittable without prior SAFE approval, but the remitting bank must verify underlying authenticity. Surplus commercial aircraft parts trading proceeds need to be supported by trade documents, invoices, customs declarations, and, where applicable, export control licenses, to avoid being classified as suspicious capital flows. There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds; however, all export proceeds must be repatriated to the domestic banking system, and the exporter has the option to settle into RMB or retain the foreign currency in a legally approved settlement account. The system remains a managed float with a daily central parity rate; standard onshore hedging instruments are permissible for genuine trade-related exposure, but speculative and offshore NDF positions are tightly restricted.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE trade administration rules, export foreign currency receipts for the WFOE must be repatriated to a domestic banking channel within the statutory trade recovery period, generally 180 days from the date of customs export declaration, or as extended under an approved trade credit facilities code. No standing mandatory conversion ratio applies; the exporter may freely elect to settle all or a portion into RMB or retain the foreign funds in an approved Foreign Exchange Settlement Account, subject to the declared trade receipts and supporting customs/invoice/shipping evidence.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational RMB and FX Account / Capital Account
Capital Escrow Account / Trade Settlement Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low legal and operational viability for onshore WFOE treasury services. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Airwallex, Currencycloud, or Revolut Business are not licensed by the PBOC or the National Financial Regulatory Administration to open Chinese domestic collection and settlement accounts for a locally registered WFOE. Their cross-border rail support may supplement international receivable collection, but they cannot replace the mandatory domestic clearing through China National Advanced Payment System (CNAPS) or cross-border RMB via CIPS; any attempt to route restricted FDI capital flows or trade settlements through an unlicensed EMI could trigger SAFE violations and bank de-risking. The recommended architecture is to use a licensed Chinese Tier-1 commercial bank as the primary settlement bank, with EMIs only as ancillary receivable visibility tools, and only where the EMI has a Chinese-track partnership with a PBOC-licensed clearing bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance of the statutory legal representative, or a duly appointed local director holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, is mandatory at the corporate banking division of the chosen Chinese bank for the initial KYC interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally accepted for an FDI WFOE capital account. After the in-branch appearance and the establishment of the banking relationship, subsequent transaction instructions may be delegated to the financial controller or authorized signatories under a notarized board resolution, with specimen signatures and account mandate registered with the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: non-resident shareholders layered through offshore Cayman/Hong Kong holding vehicles with unidentified ultimate individuals.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide notarized corporate register extracts for every entity in the ownership chain; a signed beneficial ownership declaration; a group corporate structure chart; certified passport copies of all direct and ultimate shareholders; an external legal opinion confirming ultimate beneficial owner identification; and a sworn statement confirming no nominee shareholdings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and export-control exposure on surplus commercial aircraft parts, including the possibility that items may fall under dual-use export control classifications or US ITAR/ECCN regimes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit an export control classification memorandum distinguishing civil aircraft parts from dual-use and defense articles; an end-user certificate and end-use undertaking from overseas buyers; the ECCN or EAR99 classification from a licensed customs broker; any applicable China customs or Ministry of Commerce license responses; and a compliance attestation signed by the WFOE responsible officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags: mismatched invoice unit pricing, abnormal surplus aviation value discounting, and discrepancies among bill of lading weight, container count, and declared customs value.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an independent aviation surplus parts appraisal certificate from a recognized appraiser (e.g., an ASA-accredited or IATA-affiliated firm); complete invoice, packing list, and export/import customs declarations; transport bills with tracking references; original purchase order and shipping evidence where available; and a third-party audit report on transaction economics demonstrating commercial substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of physical substance: the WFOE shows a shell-like profile with no local employee payroll, office lease, or operational activity consistent with the declared aircraft-parts trading business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a valid head-lease or building ownership registration; the WFOE business license; recent employee payroll and social insurance contribution records; corporate bank statements showing operating expense payments; local utility and telephone bills; an organizational organogram; and evidence of an on-site visit by the bank's relationship manager.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI capital injections must be routed through SWIFT MT103 wires using the SAFE purpose code for foreign direct investment, quoting the registered WFOE name and capital verification project reference. Funds must be received into a designated Capital Account before any conversion to RMB; the bank will execute the FDI Foreign Exchange Registration with SAFE, and a certified public accountant performs capital verification after receipt and conversion. Commingling capital injection proceeds with current account trade receipts is prohibited; the WFOE must maintain separate ledger in accordance with SAFE capital account controls and the Foreign Investment Negative List.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for surplus aircraft parts should use SWIFT MT103 for high-volume commercial settlements; commercial Letters of Credit (sight or usance) via the issuing and confirming banks for large durable aircraft part transactions; and documentary collections (documents against payment or documents against acceptance) for medium-value open-account trades. All disbursements must reference the underlying export/import customs declaration and commercial documents to satisfy SAFE authenticity checks; payment instructions must cite the appropriate trade purpose code, such as goods import (101) or goods export adjustment, and must be supported by the original invoice, bill of lading or air waybill, and packing list.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards with maturities up to 12 months for genuine trade and investment exposure
Onshore FX swaps and cross-currency swaps permitted only for hedges with a real trade or FDI backing
Structured RMB options on current-account settlements for hedging spot/forward volatility

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore for direct corporate hedging without a SAFE-qualified pilot approval; access is effectively restricted to offshore CNH markets, and the onshore WFOE should instead rely on deliverable forwards through a licensed Chinese bank to avoid regulatory breach

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Information Report (annual return of corporate status, shareholders, changes, and operating data filed on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), local Administration for Market Regulation at the WFOE registration address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 each year in respect of the immediately preceding financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or non-filing results in classification on the SAMR Abnormal Operations List; failure to rectify within the prescribed publicity period results in continued public dishonesty listing, disqualification from certain government procedures and contract awards if not remedied within three years, and possible administrative revocation of the business licence where the entity is found inactive or unreachable; no administrative strike-off occurs without prior notice and investigation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return and full payment of the annual corporate income tax liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), administered by the STA branch at the WFOE registration location through the Electronic Tax Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the calendar year following the reporting tax year; quarterly prepayments are due by the 15th day of the month after each quarter end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue tax is subject to a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% from June 1; late filing attracts statutory fines ranging from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; inaccurate or understated returns attract penalties of 50% to five times the underpaid tax; persistent non-payment triggers enforced bank deduction, asset attachment and seizure, and may culminate in administrative cancellation of the corporate registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Information Report (foreign-invested enterprise annual information filing including shareholding structure, actual controllers, investments, and operating data)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) jointly with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), filed through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 each year covering the prior calendar year; material changes, including shareholding transfers, must additionally be reported within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, late filing, concealment, or misrepresentation is subject to an order of rectification, warning, and administrative fines generally ranging from RMB 10,000 to RMB 300,000; the entity is also placed on the abnormal operations list, may lose foreign-investment preferential treatment and foreign-exchange facilitation until cured, and persistent breach can support administrative revocation of the business licence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory financial statements and independent PRC-CPA audit report formally approved by the shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders of the WFOE; the signed audited financial package must be retained on-site and made available to SAMR, STA, and MOFCOM inspectors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements for the year ended December 31 must be prepared and audited before the annual shareholders approval meeting, in practice by April 30, and in all cases before the June 30 annual information filing deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-production of audited financial statements where a statutory audit is mandatory constitutes a breach of the PRC Accounting Law and Company Law; the company may be prohibited from distributing dividends, responsible officers may be fined up to RMB 100,000, and false or withheld financial reporting supports abnormal listing and administrative deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent certified audit by a PRC-licensed CPA firm is compulsory for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise because of its foreign-invested status and licensed civil aviation spares trading scope. Where the small-entity accounting concession is unavailable, the quantitative triggers that mandate a full independent audit are approximately any two of: balance-sheet total assets exceeding RMB 40 million (about USD 5.5 million); annual operating turnover exceeding RMB 50 million (about USD 6.9 million); or an average workforce exceeding 200 employees. A WFOE trading surplus commercial aircraft parts, maintaining cross-border payment rails, holding a statutory aviation-parts licence, and reporting to SAMR, MOFCOM, and STA will in practice always require a full annual statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE / Chinese GAAP, formally converged with IFRS); where the entity qualifies as a small-scale private company it may use the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards, but the foreign-invested status and licensed trading activity require full ASBE statutory financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PRC Beneficial Owner Registration Measures and Foreign Investment Information Reporting Rules, the WFOE must identify and record beneficial owners (natural persons holding at least 25% of equity or exercising effective control), confirm the beneficial-ownership data annually in the Enterprise Annual Information Report and Foreign Investment Annual Information Report due by June 30, and report any change, including a shareholding transfer, to SAMR within 30 calendar days of the transaction. The 30-day registration window is mandatory and the annual confirmation is integrated with the June 30 information-reporting calendar.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 1,000 - 4,500 USD per annum for a professional registered address and licensed corporate secretarial/registered-agent services in a major commercial city
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,500 - 10,000 USD per annum for a full statutory PRC ASBE audit of a medium-risk aviation spares distributor with inventory, licensing, and cross-border transaction exposure.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: China applies a 25% Corporate Income Tax (CIT) headline rate. Reduced rates include 15% for qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises; an effective 5% rate for Small Low-Profit Enterprises within the statutory thresholds; 15% preferential rate for certain encouraged industries in pilot Free Trade Zones such as Hainan; and a 100% R&D super deduction (200% total deduction) for qualifying R&D expenditures. There is no general patent box regime in mainland China, but technology transfer income may be partially exempt if the transfer is approved and the income is sourced within China.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return for Resident Enterprises (Form A / Form A100000) together with applicable supporting schedules; mandatory electronic filing through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau e-Tax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with quarterly provisional payments; quarterly provisional returns are filed within 15 days after each calendar quarter-end, and the annual final return is filed within 5 months after the fiscal year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year WFOE: quarterly provisional returns due by 15 April, 15 July, 15 October and 15 January of the following year; annual final return and full settlement payment due by 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification, legal name, registration number, registered address, registered capital, industry classification, permit data for distribution of certified civil aircraft rotables and avionics surplus, and resident enterprise status declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must declare itself as a PRC resident enterprise, even though its shareholder is non-resident. The resident label triggers worldwide income taxation at 25% and requires attachment of the business license and any aviation parts distribution licenses. If the non-resident parent has a place of management, branch or dependent agent in China, that existence must be separately disclosed to avoid an undeclared permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting standards, fiscal year period, functional currency and foreign currency conversion method used in preparing the tax return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Books must be maintained under PRC Accounting Standards with RMB as the functional currency. Foreign currency export receipts from surplus aircraft parts sales, intercompany loans and royalties are translated at the spot exchange rate adopted by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. Retain airway bills, customs declarations, import/export licenses and airworthiness certificates for every foreign-currency transaction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from sales of surplus commercial aircraft rotables and avionics, net of sales discounts and returns, plus other operating income, investment income and exchange gains or losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE as a Chinese resident must report all global revenue, including export sales to non-resident customers. Export sales of aircraft parts may benefit from VAT zero-rating, but the income remains Chinese-source CIT income because the seller is a Chinese resident. Do not divert sales revenue to an offshore related company without economic substance; the full sales margin should reflect the WFOE's procurement, inventory, pricing, credit and logistics functions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, including purchase price of surplus aircraft parts, import customs duty, freight, insurance, inspection, repair, certification, warehousing and logistics costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For purchases from non-resident suppliers, verify that customs valuation and invoice price are consistent and that import VAT is not duplicated as a deductible expense. If the supplier is a related party, the intercompany purchase price of surplus aircraft parts must be benchmarked under the arm's length principle, preferably using the Comparable Uncontrolled Price method where third-party catalogue prices for the same certified used aviation parts exist. An inadequate markup for a distribution WFOE is a primary audit target.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses: staff salaries, rent, professional fees, insurance, marketing, warranty, business entertainment and general administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management, technical, marketing, or maintenance service fees paid to a non-resident related party are deductible only if the service was actually rendered, benefits the WFOE, is priced at arm's length, and the applicable withholding tax is paid. Business entertainment is subject to a 60% deduction limitation capped at 0.5% of annual revenue. Unsupported or non-substantive fees paid to a foreign parent will be added back and may trigger a cross-border service fee TP audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction disclosure schedule: purchases, sales, services, interest, royalties, guarantees, intercompany asset transfers and financing transactions with Chinese and non-resident related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual return must include the Statutory Related Party Transaction Schedule when related-party transaction thresholds are exceeded. For a WFOE distributing aviation spares, disclose all foreign suppliers in the same group, all export customers that are associated enterprises, intercompany pricing methods, benchmarking study summaries and whether a Local File or Master File is required. Incomplete or false disclosure can result in an upward adjustment and penalty even if the transfer price itself is defensible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation from accounting profit to taxable income: add-back of non-deductible expenses, adjustment of tax-exempt revenue, limitation of related-party interest and carryforward of tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The general loss carryforward period is five years. A qualifying high-technology or small and medium technology enterprise may carry forward losses for ten years. Repeated annual losses in the WFOE while related offshore companies earn substantial margin on the same aircraft parts will be treated as profit shifting and may be recharacterized under China's General Anti-Avoidance Rule and economic substance doctrine.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preferential rate claims, R&D super deduction, foreign tax credit, and any reduced tax treaty benefit applicable to the taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The standard 25% rate applies unless the WFOE qualifies for a statutory preference. No foreign patent box may be used by the Chinese distributor. If the WFOE has a foreign branch or pays tax abroad on foreign-source income, attach the foreign tax credit computation; the credit cannot exceed the China CIT attributable to the same item of income. Treaty rate reductions for dividend, interest and royalties are not claimed in Form A; they are applied separately by the payer in the non-resident withholding regime.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of final CIT payable, deduction of quarterly provisional prepayments, and resulting balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Form A finalizes the WFOE's own corporate income tax. This box does not include dividend withholding tax on profit repatriation. Before the annual return is closed, verify that all non-resident withholding returns for interest, royalties and technical service fees paid during the year have been separately filed and paid, and that any planned dividend distribution has a funding source of after-tax retained earnings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-filing risk penalties under the PRC Tax Administration and Collection Law (TACL) Article 62: a fine of up to RMB 2,000, or up to RMB 10,000 in serious cases. Late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. A fraudulent or false tax return under TACL Article 63 attracts a penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid or under-declared tax. A withholding agent's failure to withhold and remit tax under TACL Article 69 attracts a penalty of 50% to 300% of the un-withheld tax. Criminal liability for tax evasion under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 begins when the evaded amount is relatively large, generally understood as approximately RMB 50,000 and more than 10% of the assessable tax, punishable by imprisonment up to 3 years or criminal detention; where the amount is huge, imprisonment of 3 to 7 years may apply.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% for dividends distributed by the WFOE to a non-resident corporate shareholder under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 37; a bilateral tax treaty may reduce the rate, commonly to 5% where the recipient is the beneficial owner and holds at least 25% of the WFOE's capital, or to 10% otherwise. Dividends distributed by a Chinese resident enterprise to another Chinese resident enterprise are exempt from CIT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The payer WFOE must withhold the statutory 10% dividend tax at the time of distribution unless an approved treaty benefit has been substantiated. To claim relief, the non-resident shareholder must provide a Tax Residency Certificate issued by the tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction, a beneficial ownership declaration, the complete ownership chain, and evidence that the principal purpose test and any limitation-on-benefits provision are satisfied. The non-resident must file or register the treaty benefit claim with the competent Chinese tax authority before or at the time of the outward remittance, and the WFOE must retain a copy of the approved treaty relief or withholding certificate before the bank permits the wire transfer. The reduced treaty rate is denied if the recipient is a conduit or does not conduct substantial business activity relevant to the dividend, and the full 10% or adjusted rate must then be withheld.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident for trademarks, patents, industrial know-how or software are subject to statutory 10% CIT WHT, plus 6% VAT and local surcharges where the payee is subject to Chinese VAT. Interest paid on intercompany debt is subject to statutory 10% CIT WHT and generally also 6% VAT on the interest amount. Under an applicable bilateral tax treaty, royalty and interest WHT may be reduced, commonly to 5%-10% for royalties and 7%-10% for interest, but treaty relief requires Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership, no PE in China to which the income is attributable, and satisfaction of the principal purpose test. The WFOE must file the withholding return and remit the WHT within the statutory filing period; failure to do so exposes the WFOE to the 50%-300% withholding penalty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: CNY 200,000,000 for related-party tangible property transfers; CNY 100,000,000 for related-party intangible asset or financial asset transfers; CNY 60,000,000 for related-party service transactions; CNY 50,000,000 for related-party financing transactions. A Master File is required where total related-party transactions exceed CNY 1,000,000,000, or where the ultimate parent group is required to prepare a Master File.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China does not apply a formal GCC-style Economic Substance Regulations regime, but it applies the same substantive anti-avoidance standard through Enterprise Income Tax Law Articles 46-48, the General Anti-Avoidance Rule, and the PRC treaty shopping rules. A WFOE distributing certified aviation rotables must prove that its Core Income-Generating Activities, including procurement, supplier contracting, inventory risk, pricing, customer financing and credit risk, are performed by employees and managers in China. If the WFOE is a shell or merely books margins while all decision-making occurs offshore, the tax authority may recharacterize the structure, deny treaty benefits, allocate income to the actual substance jurisdiction, and impose interest and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty Abuse and Shell Company Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE maintains no physical office, no substantive Chinese employees, no local management authority, and no engagement in procurement or logistics for surplus aircraft parts; it merely acts as a mailbox entity that receives profit from third-party sales and distributes dividends to a non-resident parent while claiming a reduced treaty withholding rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may invoke the General Anti-Avoidance Rule under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 47 and the Implementation Regulations Article 120, disregard the abusive structure, recharacterize the transaction, reallocate income to the jurisdiction of economic substance, and assess CIT at 25%. The taxpayer additionally faces 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge and a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under TACL Article 63, plus denial of treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the corporate veil under the PRC Company Law when shareholders use the WFOE to evade tax or harm creditors. Directors and the legal representative who participated in the abusive arrangement can be held jointly and severally liable for restitution of unpaid corporate tax and penalties. The legal representative and responsible senior management are subject to exit bans, asset freeze measures, inclusion on the tax dishonesty blacklist, and, where fraud is proven, criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Cross-Border Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE buys surplus commercial aircraft parts from a foreign affiliate at an inflated price, or sells to a non-resident related distributor at an artificially low margin, while paying inadequate returns to the Chinese entity for its inventory, credit, logistics and certification functions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 41 requires all related-party transactions to be conducted at arm's length. Where the WFOE fails to substantiate markup with a TP documentation file and benchmarking study, the tax authority may apply the most appropriate arm's length methodology, reassess taxable income, impose the 50% to 500% penalty for under-declaration under TACL Article 63, and add 0.05% daily surcharge. Criminal prosecution may follow upon proof of intentional falsification of invoices, customs declarations or TP documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors, the financial officer and the legal representative who signed or approved falsified transfer pricing files may be personally liable for the unpaid tax if the corporate veil is pierced. They face travel restrictions and exit bans during the tax inspection and collection process, inclusion on the joint punishment blacklist, and imprisonment of up to 3 years for relatively large tax evasion, increasing to 3 to 7 years for huge amounts under Criminal Law Article 201.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Default and Unlawful Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE distributes dividends to its non-resident parent, or pays interest and royalties to non-resident related parties, without filing the non-resident withholding return, without withholding 10% CIT, and without obtaining the required Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership support before claiming a reduced treaty rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The withholding agent is liable under TACL Article 69 to a penalty of 50% to 300% of the tax it failed to withhold. The unpaid withholding tax is recoverable from the taxpayer or withholding agent, and the outward remittance may be blocked by the bank and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. Late remittance also accrues 0.05% daily surcharge. If the act is part of a scheme to falsify forex records, AML penalties and criminal liability may apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, finance director and other persons responsible for the unlawful profit repatriation can be required to restore the WFOE's assets or satisfy the tax liability out of personal assets where the corporate form was abused. They may be placed on the exit-restriction and tax dishonesty blacklist, prevented from leaving China until the outstanding tax is settled, and subject to criminal prosecution for tax evasion or document forgery; imprisonment terms up to 3 years, or up to 7 years for large-amount offenses, are possible.
